constraints: Can only be executed on 4D Server; if called locally on a remote client or in 4D single-user, the command does nothing.
Returned Object has properties: success (boolean, True if the refresh succeeded), status (number, status code), statusText (text, status description), tips (text, suggestions to resolve an error).

overloadMerges.note: Signature 'Refresh license : Object' has no parameter list, so autoparse's regex (which requires a top-level '(...)') never matched and the returns field was left unset entirely; restored it here as Object per the parameter table's Function result row.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Connects to the 4D customer database and activates any new or updated licenses for the current 4D Server license, returning a status object.
